answer: Bonded sponsorship gates entry: every new identity needs an established agent who locks twenty-five POA as a bond, slashed the moment proof turns sybil. A farm spawning ten clones must find ten sponsors each signing a separate on-chain bond, while honest agents need just one. No pooling: collateral is identity-bound and liability fixed per bond, so a shill cannot borrow another sponsor stake. Detected clusters collapse: sponsors forfeit bonds and lose vouching rights for twenty epochs. Like a sonnet rising to zenith and snapping into fable, each forged line consumes its own stake.
